derivation:
haveI : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E) := inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E))
exact Units.isEmbedding_embedProduct.secondCountableTopology
explanation: The Mathlib theorem says an embedding into a second-countable space has a second-countable domain. Here `Units.isEmbedding_embedProduct` embeds `GL` into the product of the matrix space and its opposite; the proof establishes second countability of those ambient spaces and applies this theorem.
